parent.title: Vibe coding workshop playbook (2-3 h, laymen, 2026)

siblings.title: Workshop-scale app ideas for laymen
siblings.summary: Five reliable app-idea menus that a non-developer can ship in 2-3 hours with an AI builder, plus the failure modes to swap out.

siblings.title: Vibe-coding tool stack on shared wifi, low budget
siblings.summary: Lovable as the default with Bolt.new as the backup, hosted hotspot for wifi, $0–$50 host spend for 20 attendees, and signup done the night before.

siblings.title: Take-home deployment for non-technical participants
siblings.summary: Picking the workshop deploy stack that survives the two-week tail.

siblings.title: Facilitation logistics and failure modes
siblings.summary: The pre-flight checklist, room/tool fallbacks, and the failure modes that actually sink 2-3 hour vibe coding workshops.

sources.title: Lovable docs — ChatGPT app
sources.claim: Lovable's official ChatGPT app: tagging @Lovable hands the conversation context to Lovable as the initial build; no credits are charged until the build fires; further editing requires opening Lovable.

sources.title: Lovable — ChatGPT app
sources.claim: Marketing page for the ChatGPT app integration; positions the workflow as plan-in-ChatGPT, build-in-Lovable, results in minutes.

sources.title: Lovable docs — Prompting best practices
sources.claim: Lovable's official prompting best practices: four-question planning frame, design buzzwords, build by component, real content over placeholders, clarifying-questions tail, and the edit template.

sources.title: Lovable — Prompting handbook
sources.claim: The Lovable Prompting Bible: canonical long-form reference covering training-wheels prompting, meta-prompting, reverse meta-prompting, and the plan-then-build discipline.

sources.title: Lovable — Chat mode & questions
sources.claim: Lovable's Chat Mode allows planning conversations before any code is written; introduced with the follow-up questions feature; default behaviour is still instant generation.

sources.title: Lovable docs — Modes
sources.claim: Lovable's documentation of Agent (Build) mode and Plan mode; Plan mode is for decision-making, Agent mode is for execution.

sources.title: Lovable docs — Plans & credits
sources.claim: Lovable free plan provides 5 daily credits with a 30/month cap; Pro starts at $25/month for 100 credits.

sources.title: Design Bootcamp — From prompt to prototype
sources.claim: Lightweight-PRD discipline: stable naming for panels/buttons/cards because small label changes can ripple through file paths.

sources.title: MorphLLM — Reddit vibe-coding aggregation
sources.claim: Aggregated Reddit feedback on Lovable: fix-one-break-ten is the dominant complaint; 170 of 1,645 Lovable apps had vulnerabilities exposing PII.

sources.title: Banani — Lovable pricing & credits
sources.claim: Per-prompt credit costs: ~0.5 for a styling change, ~1.2 for adding authentication, ~2 for building a landing page.

sources.title: Build with Lovable — 15 prompt examples
sources.claim: Concrete starter-prompt example for a budgeting app aimed at Gen Z freelancers, illustrating the audience+CTA+aesthetic structure.

sources.title: Lowcode Agency — Lovable prompting guide
sources.claim: Three-strike correction rule: after three targeted corrections with no improvement, stop iterating and reassess the approach.

sources.title: AI4DH — Vibe coding workshop
sources.claim: Existence-proof of a real beginner-targeted vibe-coding workshop in May 2026 (Univ. of Ljubljana / AI4DH) requiring no programming experience.

sources.title: AI Agents Kit — Lovable prompting guide
sources.claim: Lovable interprets specific design buzzwords (minimal, expressive, cinematic, playful, premium, developer-focused) as parameters affecting typography, spacing, shadow, radius, and palette.

sources.title: Lovable PRD Generator (Custom GPT)
sources.claim: Public Custom GPT 'Lovable PRD Generator' that packages an idea into a Lovable-shaped prompt automatically.

sources.title: cporter202/lovable-for-beginners (GitHub)
sources.claim: Community beginner course repo for Lovable — usable as a workshop example bank.

sources.title: Coursera — Vibe Coding with Lovable
sources.claim: Published Coursera course establishing the 'first app in 1-2 hours' expectation as the beginner norm for Lovable.
